title: Continuous abelian functions form an fpqc sheaf
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian group equipped with a topology for which addition and negation are continuous; no Hausdorff or separation condition is imposed. On the category of schemes [def-pc-scheme], the presheaf $U\mapsto C(|U|,A)$ of continuous functions with pointwise addition, and restrictions $g\mapsto g\circ |f|$ along scheme morphisms $f$, is a sheaf of abelian groups for the fpqc topology [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Here $|U|$ is the underlying Zariski topological space and $C(|U|,A)$ consists of all continuous maps to the specified topology on $A$.
